Maya (Growth): Heads up — weekly dashboard shows cohort velocity dip for the webinar cohort, roughly 20% lower MQL->SQL this past 48h. Anyone else seeing a sudden shift on Pulseboard?
Ben (Marketing Ops): I can confirm, spike in 'unknown/referral' for that cohort. Could be attribution loss.
Sophie (Product Marketing): Is this cohort the new landing page variant B traffic? We swapped copy last week.
Maya (Growth): Yes variant B. Funnel looks fine except lead routing latency increased for a chunk of leads.
Tom (RevOps): SFDC ingest logs show a 4-7h lag on Tue between capture -> lead create for ~40% of records. Not typical but still under the ingestion SLA.
AnalyticsBot: Alert: cohort_velocity drop >15% for cohort=webinar-2025-11-10, metric=MQL_to_SQL, triggered at 2025-11-04T09:12Z.
Jamal (CM): Sales reported missing leads Tue afternoon — they pinged ops.
Ben (Marketing Ops): Looking at tracking, ~1.2k sessions between 13:00-15:00 UTC had missing UTM campaign param. GA shows those as 'referral'.
Sophie (Product Marketing): We pushed a redirect at Tue 12:45 — timeline matches. Could the redirect be stripping query params?
Maya (Growth): Timeline aligns. Hypothesis A: redirect removed UTM -> misattribution and cohort shrink. Hypothesis B: SFDC lag delayed MQL creation causing apparent velocity drop.
Tom (RevOps): Action: I'll pull raw querystring + SFDC created_at for a sample set from that window and post findings in 30m.
Ben (Marketing Ops): I'll patch the redirect to preserve query params (`301 preserve`) and add a server-side guard so we don't lose params again. Rolling change now. :rocket:
Maya (Growth): Also can we add a lightweight dashboard tile for 'UTM completeness by hour' so ops can catch this faster next time?
Ben (Marketing Ops): Created a ticket and quick task. Will try to get a tile by EOD: https://app.asana.com/0/12345/67890
AnalyticsBot: Dashboard snapshot saved as `cohort-velocity-2025-11-04-0945.png`
Jamal (CM): For Friday's weekly review, let's flag this as 'data hygiene' and not a messaging failure unless we confirm otherwise.
Sophie (Product Marketing): Should we pause pushing variant B via paid channels until attribution is stable?
Maya (Growth): Keep variant live for organic but pause new paid spend on it until we confirm fixes.
Tom (RevOps): Sample pulled — 54 leads in window; 42 missing `utm_campaign`, 38 had SFDC created_at delayed 4-7h. Raw logs excerpt below: ```
13:02:17 GET /lp?utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email
13:03:01 GET /lp
13:14:55 GET /lp?utm_source=test
```
Ben (Marketing Ops): Quick update: redirect fix deployed 13:28 UTC, server-side param-preserve active.
AnalyticsBot: Preliminary metric update: UTM completeness returned to baseline after fix.
Maya (Growth): Good. Agreed next steps: (1) Fix redirect (Ben) — done/in progress. (2) Add UTM completeness tile (Ben) — EOD. (3) Update weekly KPI deck with footnote and temporary adjusted cohort window (-1d) (Sophie) — by Friday. (4) Notify Sales to re-check Tue leads (Jamal) — sent.
Sophie (Product Marketing): I'll prep the slide with source breakdown and a short troubleshooting note for Sales.
Tom (RevOps): I'll follow up to reassign any duplicates and confirm no leads were lost.
Maya (Growth): Thanks team. We'll monitor the cohort for 72h and revisit at the Friday KPI review. Flagging this for discussion under 'dashboard signal fidelity'. :white_check_mark:
